dialogue.content: こんばんは、カウンセラー役です。本日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm the counselor. It's a pleasure to speak with you today.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。本日はよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for having me today.

dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談員です。本日はよろしくお願いします。本日はどのような相談内容になりますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Good evening, I’m the counselor. Thank you for meeting with me today. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 受験がとても不安です
dialogue.English: I'm very anxious about my entrance exams.

dialogue.content: 受験は不安になりますよね。今は高校生ですか？
dialogue.English: Entrance exams can be anxiety-provoking, can't they? Are you in high school now?

dialogue.content: 高校生です
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm a high school student.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。高校三年生で大学受験ということでよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. So, you're a third-year high school student preparing for university entrance exams, is that correct?

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 大学受験はいろいろ不安になりますよね。どの辺が不安に感じますか？
dialogue.English: University entrance exams can bring up a lot of anxieties. What aspects are you feeling anxious about?

dialogue.content: いまだに志望校が決められなくて、
dialogue.English: I still haven't been able to decide on which university I want to apply to,

dialogue.content: 受験はどんどん近づいてくるし、どうすればいいのか分からないです
dialogue.English: and the exams are getting closer and closer, so I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: なるほど。それは焦ってしまいすよね。いつ頃までに決めるべき物なのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must make you feel rushed. Is there a certain time by which you need to decide?

dialogue.content: 早ければ早いほど良いです、志望校独自のテストがあるので…
dialogue.English: The sooner the better, because some universities have their own unique tests...

dialogue.content: そうですよね。勉強のこととかも考えると早いに越したことはないですよね。何か決まらない要因とか、教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Considering your studies, the earlier you decide, the better. Can you tell me about any factors that are making it difficult to decide?

dialogue.content: やりたいことがなくて、どこの学部を選べばいいのかが分からないんです
dialogue.English: I don't have anything I particularly want to do, so I don't know which faculty to choose.

dialogue.content: 大学自体は近所でいいかなって思うんですけど、学部を選べなくて…
dialogue.English: I think a university nearby would be fine, but I can’t decide on a faculty...

dialogue.content: うんうん。逆にやりたいことがないから、やりたいことを見つけに大学に行くってのも大事ですよね。学部選びも重要ですよね。候補の学部とかはあるんですか？
dialogue.English: I understand. On the other hand, not having something specific you want to do can be a reason to go to university to explore and find it. Choosing a faculty is important, too. Do you have any candidates in mind?

dialogue.content: 強いて言うなら、文系なので、
dialogue.English: Well, if I had to say, since I'm more into liberal arts,

dialogue.content: 文学部とか法学部？とかになるんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: maybe something like the Faculty of Letters or the Faculty of Law?

dialogue.content: 理系は苦手なので、そこは無理かなって思います
dialogue.English: I'm not good with science and math, so I don't think that's an option for me.

dialogue.content: 苦手な学部に4年間通うのはあまりおすすめできないですよね。
dialogue.English: Spending four years in a faculty you're not good at probably isn't the best idea.

dialogue.content: 文学部と法学部は何か思うにあたった、印象とかきっかけはある感じですか？
dialogue.English: Did you have any particular impression or reason for thinking of the Faculty of Letters and the Faculty of Law?

dialogue.content: 学校で卒業生の話を聞く日があったんですけど、そこで文学部とか法学部の先輩が文系でしたって言ってて、それで知りました。
dialogue.English: We had a day at school where we listened to alumni talk, and some seniors from the Faculty of Letters and Faculty of Law said they were liberal arts majors, so that's how I learned about them.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そういう機会があったんですね！その話を聞いてどう思いました？
dialogue.English: I see, so you had an opportunity like that! What did you think after hearing their stories?

dialogue.content: 文学部の先輩は、日本の仏像とかそういう昔の文化について調べてるって言ってて、何してるんだろうって思いました(笑)
dialogue.English: The senior from the Faculty of Letters said they were researching things like Japanese Buddhist statues and ancient culture, and I thought, "What are they even doing?" (laughs)

dialogue.content: 法学部の先輩は、公務員になりたいからって言っていました
dialogue.English: The senior from the Faculty of Law said it was because they wanted to become a civil servant.

dialogue.content: 公務員はありだなーって思うんですけど、法学に興味はないからちょっと迷います。
dialogue.English: I think being a civil servant is a decent option, but I'm not interested in law, so I'm a bit hesitant.

dialogue.content: うんうん、双方悩ましいことですよね。今の二人を聞いてると、好きなことを調べに進学したと、就職のために進学したっていう印象かな？
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, both are tricky options. Hearing about those two, I get the impression that one went on to study what they love, while the other went on for the sake of a job. Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: そうですね、そんな感じでした
dialogue.English: Yes, that's the feeling I got.

dialogue.content: やりたいことが決まってていいなって思いました
dialogue.English: I thought it must be nice to know what you want to do.

dialogue.content: そう感じられたのですね。でも大事なのはサクラさんの考えなので、あまり人と比較しない方が気持ちは楽になるかもしれないですよね。
dialogue.English: I see you felt that way. But what's important is what you think, Sakura. Not comparing yourself to others might make you feel a bit more at ease.

dialogue.content: サクラさんは過去どんなことをしているのが好きでしたか？
dialogue.English: Sakura, what kinds of things did you enjoy doing in the past?

dialogue.content: なるほど、たしかに比べるのはあんまり良くないかもしれないですね。
dialogue.English: I see. You're right, comparing myself probably isn't a good thing.

dialogue.content: 好きなこと…
dialogue.English: Things I enjoy...

dialogue.content: そうですね…ピアノは好きでした
dialogue.English: Let's see... I liked the piano.

dialogue.content: ピアノが好きだったんですね！どういうところが好きでした？
dialogue.English: So you liked the piano! What did you like about it?

dialogue.content: 弾くのも好きなんですけど、聴くのが特に好きですね
dialogue.English: I like playing it, but I especially like listening to it.

dialogue.content: 弾く人によって音色が変わるので、そこも面白いなって思います
dialogue.English: The tone changes depending on the player, which I find interesting.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね！ピアノの音はいいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see! The sound of a piano is beautiful, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、聴いていてすごく気持ちいいです
dialogue.English: Yes, it's very pleasant to listen to.

dialogue.content: 学部で探すのも一つですけど、何かピアノとかの歴史を知る授業があったり、部活、サークルとかそういう観点で探すのもアリかもしれないですよね。
dialogue.English: Looking by faculty is one way, but you could also search from other angles—for example, for classes on the history of the piano, or clubs and circles related to it. That might be an option, too.

dialogue.content: なるほどー
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: サクラさんはどうして大学に行こうと思われてるんですか？
dialogue.English: What makes you want to go to university, Sakura?

dialogue.content: 大学までは出た方がいいかなって思っていて
dialogue.English: I just feel like it's better to at least graduate from university.

dialogue.content: うんうん。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 親もそう言ってますし、周りの友達もみんな大学に進学するので、
dialogue.English: My parents say so too, and all my friends are going to university,

dialogue.content: それが普通なのかなと言うか、当たり前のように思います
dialogue.English: so I guess it feels like the normal or natural thing to do.

dialogue.content: なるほど、確かにその感覚はよく分かります。だからこそ迷ってしまいますもんね。
dialogue.English: I see, I can certainly understand that feeling. That's exactly why it can be so confusing.

dialogue.content: 高卒と大卒だと給料も違うとか聴いたこともあるので、それなら大学行こうかなって思います
dialogue.English: I've also heard that the salary is different for high school graduates and university graduates, so that makes me think I should go to university.

dialogue.content: 給料も大事ですよね。。仕事についてはどのようにお考えですか？
dialogue.English: Salary is important, isn't it... What are your thoughts about work?

dialogue.content: どこかの会社に就職を考えています
dialogue.English: I'm thinking of getting a job at some company.

dialogue.content: まだやりたいことがないので、職種とかは分からないですけど、会社員でいいかなーと。
dialogue.English: I don't have anything I want to do yet, so I don't know the type of job, but I think being an office worker would be fine.

dialogue.content: 立派な目標だと思いますよ！どういう学部の人が、会社員になりやすいとかありますか？
dialogue.English: I think that’s a solid goal! Are there certain faculties whose graduates tend to become office workers more easily?

dialogue.content: そこまではまだ調べてなかったです
dialogue.English: I haven't looked into that yet.

dialogue.content: 目の前の勉強に追われてて…
dialogue.English: I've been so busy with the studies right in front of me...

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。でも調べてみると学部は意外と関係ないかもしれないですよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. But when you look into it, you may find that your faculty doesn’t matter as much as you might think.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね！
dialogue.English: Oh, really?

dialogue.content: じゃあ何学部でもいいんですかね…？
dialogue.English: Then does that mean any faculty would be okay...?

dialogue.content: なんでもってなると、範囲が拡がりすぎちゃうかもしれないから、難しいけど、
dialogue.English: Saying "anything" might make the range too broad, so it's tricky, but...

dialogue.content: 少しでも興味があったり、何か自分が成長できるかなとか、あるといいよね。あと、やりたいことが見つかりそうとか。
dialogue.English: it would be good to have something you're even a little interested in, or something you think you could grow from. Or maybe a place where you think you could find what you want to do.

dialogue.content: 先のことは誰にも分からないですもんね
dialogue.English: No one knows what the future holds, after all.

dialogue.content: そうですね、せっかく行くなら自分のためになることがしたいなって思います
dialogue.English: That's true. Since I'm going, I want to do something that will benefit me.

dialogue.content: いいですね！とても前向きな意見だと思います！
dialogue.English: That's great! I think that's a very positive way of looking at it!

dialogue.content: 成長とか考えちゃうので、余計にやりたいことが見つからないのが引っかかってしまうきがします
dialogue.English: I think about things like personal growth, so not being able to find something I want to do bothers me even more.

dialogue.content: そうだよね、先々になってしまいますもんね。やりたいことが無いと、大学には行きづらいですか？
dialogue.English: I get that—it pushes your focus into the future. Does not having something you want to do make it hard to go to university?

dialogue.content: 行きたい学部がふんわりしたまま行くと、賭けに出るみたいなイメージがあります。
dialogue.English: If I go with only a vague idea of a faculty, it feels like taking a gamble.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そう感じると少し怖いですよね。一回整理しましょうか！
dialogue.English: I see, that must feel a bit scary. Shall we try to organize your thoughts?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします！
dialogue.English: Yes, please!

dialogue.content: サクラさんは大学に明確に行きたい学部はなく不安に感じている。現状大学に行くのは当たり前だし通過点である。現状決まっているのは理系ではなく、文系。法学部と文学部の人の話を聞いた。ピアノを聴くのが好き。
dialogue.English: Okay, so Sakura, you're feeling anxious because you don't have a clear faculty you want to go to. Right now, you see going to university as a natural stepping stone. You've decided on the humanities, not sciences. You heard stories from people in the Faculty of Law and Faculty of Letters. And you like listening to the piano.

dialogue.content: 現状では会社員になるのも一つと考えている。
dialogue.English: And for now, you're considering becoming an office worker as one possibility.

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。近場の大学がいいかなってありましたよね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. You also mentioned that a university nearby would be good, right?

dialogue.content: はい、近所です！
dialogue.English: Yes, somewhere local.

dialogue.content: やりたいことは今はなくても、一度近所の大学の文系学部をリスト化して、そこからご自身の行ける範囲の学部をピックアップして順位とかつけるのはどうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Even if you don’t have a clear interest yet, how about first listing the humanities faculties at nearby universities, then picking out the ones within your academic reach and ranking them?

dialogue.content: そうすると絞れて、そこから何か理由が生まれるかもしれないですよね。
dialogue.English: By narrowing it down that way, reasons for your choices might emerge.

dialogue.content: なるほど！近所すらまだ調べてなかったので、そこからやってみようと思います！
dialogue.English: I see! I haven't even looked up the nearby ones yet, so I'll start from there!

dialogue.content: 文系で絞れば少しは見えてきそうな気がします
dialogue.English: If I narrow it down to the humanities, I feel like things might become a bit clearer.

dialogue.content: いろいろやることがあって、大変だとは思いますが、無理しない範囲で決まるといいですよね！
dialogue.English: I know you have a lot to do and it must be tough, but I hope you can make a decision without overdoing it!

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you!

dialogue.content: そろそろ相談終了の時間なのですが、本日は相談してみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: We are coming up on the end of our time. How was it for you to talk today?

dialogue.content: はい、何も調べてなかったのでそれは焦りもあるなって思いました。やることが見えたので、なんだかやる気が出てきました
dialogue.English: Yes, I realized that I was feeling rushed because I hadn't done any research. Now that I see what I need to do, I feel motivated.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: それはよかったです！ではこちらで相談終了させて頂きます、本日ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I’m glad to hear that. We will end the session here—thank you very much for today.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much!

dialogue.content: （至らない点多かったと思いますが、本日ありがとうございました。システム終了させていただきます。）
dialogue.English: (I'm sure there were many shortcomings, but thank you for today. I will now end the system.)
